idle_side.prompt: Stands still in a relaxed pose; its body rises and falls very slightly and its tail sways a little. It stays in place, facing right.

idle_down.prompt: Stands still in a relaxed pose; its body rises and falls very slightly and its tail sways a little. It stays in place, facing the viewer the whole time.

idle_up.prompt: Stands still in a relaxed pose; its body rises and falls very slightly and its tail sways a little. It stays in place with its back to the viewer the whole time.

walk_side.prompt: Walks in place: its legs step one after the other, its body bobs gently with each step and its tail sways. It stays in place, facing right.

walk_down.prompt: Walks in place: its legs step one after the other, its body bobs gently with each step and its tail sways. It stays in place, facing the viewer the whole time.
walk_down.method: walk_front.py (walk gait from the down drawing)

walk_up.prompt: Walks in place: its legs step one after the other, its body bobs gently with each step and its tail sways. It stays in place with its back to the viewer the whole time.

run_down.prompt: Runs in place with long fast strides, its body leaning forward and its tail held straight out behind. It stays in place, facing the viewer the whole time.

run_up.prompt: Runs in place with long fast strides, its body leaning forward and its tail held straight out behind. It stays in place with its back to the viewer the whole time.
